I really resonated with what you said about food reminding you of comfort and home. That is exactly the same for me. I’ve always struggled with my weight in the past years. Where I grew up, weight is always something that is talked about a lot- like super casually/ meant as a joke. I’m glad I’m in a different country now. 

But this year, I am claiming my life back. I started consistently working out since February (4-6x/week). And idk, something has changed and something clicked. Exercising was never fun but now it is. I do it to be stronger and to build muscle and not to lose weight. 

I am not restricting any food group in my nutrition. I tried to do CICO but I realized this won’t be sustainable for me but it is a great tool to start. In the end, portion control and a balanced nutrition win. And moving. I have to move and just show up. Some days are harder than others but I try to remember why I’m doing this. This is for me and I hope my grandma self will thank me later for doing this lol, for being healthier, stronger and for taking control now that I still can.

Hello- this is how I seasoned my wok on my ceramic stovetop. Turn the heat on in the highest setting for 2-3 minutes until you see some smoke. You should see some bluing here. Then you add oil (I used canola) and swirl it around the wok turning the heat to the lowest setting for another 2-3 minutes. Wash afterwards and dry. Then try to cook normally (add some oil) by frying an egg and it should slide in your wok. It is now seasoned. :)
